# Privacy notice: instructor development

Version $version

This notice tells you what the technical training function records about you as an instructor,
why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and what your rights are.

## Who is responsible

<!-- element: controller-identity -->
The organisation is the controller of these records. Questions about this notice go to $dpo_email.

$held

## Recordings

Learners appear in session recordings. Recordings stay where they are; this system stores a link
and timestamps, not a copy. Observers use recordings only for observation and coaching.

## Your rights

- You can see your full record.
- You can reply to every decision about you.
- You can appeal a decision to the head of training.
- You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction or, where it applies, portability.

You can object at any time to processing that rests on our legitimate interests.

$consent

$complaint

## Automated decisions

No decision about you is made by automated means alone. Rules check that the evidence is
complete; named people make every decision.
